newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline edge up $1 but trading stays thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline edge up $1 but trading stays thin.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices rose $1 a tonne on Monday in thin trading.
Rotterdam barges traded at $194 fob early in the afternoon but otherwise swaps activity was thin with talk around $185 for both July and August.
"July looks nasty because of the oil stored ahead of the budget," said a trader, referring to UK companies hoarding ahead of possible tax hikes in July.
High refinery runs in the U.S. and Europe are also likely to keep a lid on prices despite low stocks in Europe which languish over 4 percent under year ago levels.
